title: No Fixed Configuration Is Best: Context- and Cost-Aware Tuning of LLM Pipelines, with an Application to Schema Matching and Mapping
abstract: arXiv:2611.31864v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The numeric settings of a multi-stage LLM pipeline (a compound AI system) are the usual target of tuning. We tuned all of them for an LLM pipeline for schema matching and mapping, with accuracy and cost as joint objectives, and we show what this buys, what it cannot buy, and where the remaining accuracy is. First, tuning buys cost and a little accuracy. On 35 tasks, with whole groups of tasks held out from tuning, one tuned configuration gains 2.9 points of top-1 accuracy (HR@1) over the default at 18% more cost, and another keeps the accuracy of the default at 32% lower cost. Second, the accuracy depends on a choice that numeric tuning cannot reach. Restricting the search for each source column to one assigned target table changes HR@1 by +30 points on a MIMIC-III to OMOP task and by -52 points on a task built from database views, more than numeric tuning gains on nine of ten test tasks. translated_title: 没有固定配置是最优的：LLM流水线的上下文与成本感知调优，及其在模式匹配与映射中的应用
translated_abstract: 多阶段LLM流水线（复合AI系统）的数值参数设置通常是调优的目标。我们针对一个用于模式匹配与映射的LLM流水线，以准确率和成本为联合目标，对其全部数值设置进行了调优，并展示了调优能带来什么、不能带来什么，以及剩余的准确率来自何处。首先，调优能带来成本节约和少量准确率提升。在35个任务上（调优时将整组任务留出作测试），一个调优配置相比默认配置以增加18%的成本换来了2.9个百分点的top-1准确率（HR@1）提升，另一个调优配置则以降低32%的成本保持了默认配置的准确率。其次，准确率还取决于一个数值调优无法触及的选择。将每个源列的搜索限制在一个指定的目标表中，在MIMIC-III到OMOP的任务上使HR@1变化+30个百分点，而在一个由数据库视图构建的任务上变化-52个百分点，这一影响超过了数值调优在十个测试任务中九个上的收益。没有哪种设置对所有任务都合适。
tldr: 论文以准确率和成本为联合目标对模式匹配与映射LLM流水线进行数值调优，发现调优只能带来有限准确率提升或成本节约，而一个数值调优无法触及的配置选择（如是否将源列搜索限制到单一目标表）对不同任务的准确率影响远大于数值调优，因此不存在对所有任务都最优的固定配置。
en_tdlr: Tuning the numeric settings of an LLM pipeline for schema matching and mapping yields only modest accuracy gains or cost savings, while a configuration choice beyond numeric tuning (e.g., restricting each source column's search to one assigned target table) shifts accuracy far more across tasks, showing that no single fixed configuration is best for all tasks.
